   - Redwood legal review complete: by 2026-09-17 morning
   - DocuSign send: 2026-09-17 afternoon
   - Target signature window (both sides): 2026-09-17 to 2026-09-18 EOD
   - Provisioning kickoff: 2026-09-21 (morning)

3) Runbook highlights (short):
   - Pre-provision: finalize SOW, confirm data retention and region (us-west), share onboarding list.
   - Provision: allocate Dedicated capacity pool, pin model and quantization profile.
   - Day 1: smoke tests, sample traffic, 1:1 onboarding call with Eng lead.

I attached our redline of the SOW (Redwood-SOW-Nimbus-redline.docx). Internal ask: Grace — can you confirm legal ETA and whether Laura should be the primary signer? Dev — can you confirm engineering lead availability on the 21st and whether we need extra ramp days?
